title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on the Issue of Whether a Party Who Did Not Appeal in the Original Trial Should Pay Case Acceptance Fees When Filing an Appeal After Remand for Retrial
keywords_en: Whether a party filing an appeal should pay the case acceptance fee
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Official Reply on Whether a Party Who Did Not Appeal at the Original Trial but Files an Appeal After Remand for Retrial Should Pay Case Acceptance Fees

Fa [1998] No. 41

Anhui High People's Court:

Your court's Request for Instructions on Whether a Party Who Did Not Appeal at the Original Trial but Files an Appeal After Remand for Retrial Should Pay Case Acceptance Fees (Wan Gao Fa [1998] No. 82) has been received. Upon deliberation, the reply is as follows:

Article 17 of the Measures for Litigation Fees of the People's Courts provides: "For cases remanded for retrial by the appellate court of second instance, the prepaid appellate case acceptance fees shall not be refunded; if an appeal is filed again after retrial, no further prepayment of case acceptance fees shall be required." The phrase "if an appeal is filed again after retrial" as used herein refers to the party who filed the appeal at the original trial and files an appeal again after retrial, and does not include a party who did not appeal at the original trial but files an appeal after retrial. Pursuant to the relevant provisions of Article 13, Paragraph 2 of the Measures for Litigation Fees of the People's Courts, "the litigation costs in an appellate case shall be prepaid by the appellant when submitting the notice of appeal to the People's Court. If both parties file an appeal, both appealing parties shall separately prepay the litigation costs." At the original trial, the party who filed an appeal had already prepaid the appellate case acceptance fees, and those fees were not refunded when the appellate court of second instance remanded the case for retrial. Therefore, when that party files an appeal again after retrial, no further prepayment is required. However, a party who did not file an appeal at the original trial and files an appeal after retrial is exercising the right to appeal for the first time, and shall therefore prepay the appellate case litigation costs in accordance with the relevant provisions.

It is so replied.

April 23, 1998
